reachable.name: Return to the Guild
reachable.objective: Deliver the artifact to the Guild Master and claim your reward.

window.speaker: DM Narrator
window.text: The guild hall is loud with evening drinkers; lanterns sway above the crowded job board.

window.speaker: Arin
window.text: "Pick something that pays, Max. My boots have holes in them."

window.speaker: Max
window.text: I run a finger down the notices and stop at the one stamped with a sun. "This one. The Sun Ruins." I tear it off the board.

window.speaker: DM Narrator
window.text: Morning light slants through the shutters onto Ponticius's counter.

window.speaker: Ponticius
window.text: "Sign here. You leave the day after tomorrow, and not a day later."

window.speaker: Arin
window.text: "Two days to pack. Generous."

window.speaker: Max
window.text: I sign the contract. "We'll get our gear together tonight and sort out who's coming."

window.speaker: DM Narrator
window.text: At dawn the town gate creaks open; the desert beyond is still blue with shadow.

window.speaker: Luke
window.text: "Please, Max. I can carry the water. I won't slow you down."

window.speaker: Arin
window.text: "He'll follow us anyway. Better he walks where I can see him."

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "Fine. You come, Luke, but you stay behind Arin the whole way." We head out through the gate together.

window.text: The sun hangs straight overhead; the desert road shimmers and there is no shade anywhere.

cast.role: Captain of the salvage ship; decisive, gives the orders

cast.role: The ship's engineer; handles the reactor, engines and repairs

reachable.name: Restore Main Power
reachable.objective: Bring the reactor back online.

reachable.name: Abandon Ship
reachable.objective: Get everyone into the escape pods.

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: The engine room is a cage of pipes and red warning light; the reactor hums unevenly.

window.speaker: Pell
window.text: "Coolant loop two is fried. I can bypass it if you hold this valve."

window.speaker: Captain Okafor
window.text: Okafor's voice crackles over the comm from the bridge: "How long, Pell?"

window.speaker: Max
window.text: I grab the valve. "Give me the wrench, Pell. Let's bring her back up."

window.text: Midnight at the Blue Anchor: neon hums, smoke hangs under the ceiling, and Maeve is halfway through her last set.

window.text: Mae leans in beside me. "She's scared. Look at her hands."

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "After her set, we talk to Maeve. Quietly."
